title: Counit transport of a sheaf-valued lax monoidal functor
statement:
Fix a universe $\mathcal V$, two $\mathcal V$-small sites $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and a closed braided monoidal Grothendieck abelian category $\mathcal A$ relative to $\mathcal V$, with $\mathcal V$-small morphism sets. Use the canonical sheafified pointwise tensors and strong monoidal sheafification functors of [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators]. Write $a_C\dashv U_C$, $a_D\dashv U_D$ for sheafification and full inclusion, with units $\eta_C,\eta_D$ and counits $\epsilon_C,\epsilon_D$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. For presheaves write $\otimes_p$ for pointwise tensor and $I_C,I_D$ for its units. Thus the sheaf tensor on $C$ is $H\otimes L=a_C(U_CH\otimes_p U_CL)$ and its tensorator is $\mu^{a_C}_{P,Q}:a_CP\otimes a_CQ\to a_C(P\otimes_p Q)$. Put $t_D(F,G)=\eta_{D,U_DF\otimes_p U_DG}$ and $u_D=\eta_{D,I_D}$. Let $E:C\to D$ be a functor such that $r(P)=P\circ E^{\mathrm{op}}$ preserves these coefficient-valued sheaves, and write $R$ for its sheaf restriction, so $U_CR=rU_D$. Give $U_D$ the right-adjoint mate lax structure [lem-sfb-monoidal-adjunction-mates], give $r$ its pointwise strong structure, and transport the composite lax structure of $a_CrU_D$ to $R$ along $\epsilon_CR$.

For every pair $H,L$ of sheaves on $C$, the counits are invertible and satisfy
$$
\mu^{a_C}_{U_CH,U_CL}\circ(\epsilon_{C,H}^{-1}\otimes\epsilon_{C,L}^{-1})=1_{H\otimes L}.
$$
For every pair $F,G$ of sheaves on $D$, the transported tensor and unit comparisons are
$$
\mu_{R,F,G}=\epsilon_{C,R(F\otimes G)}\circ a_C(r(t_D(F,G))),\qquad e_R=\epsilon_{C,R\mathbf1_D}\circ a_C(r(u_D)).
$$
All object identifications are the prescribed sheafified tensor and unit identifications.
